app_fee.value: The Graduate School of Arts and Sciences application fee is $85, paid online and not refundable.
app_fee.quote: The application fee of $85 is payable through the online application by credit card or e-check

fee_waiver.value: Tufts offers application fee waivers to international applicants too, decided case by case on financial need.
fee_waiver.quote: Tufts offers application fee waivers for both domestic and international applicants.

also.quote: We also consider application fee waiver requests on a case-by-case basis, based on financial need.

gre_general.value: The GRE is set by each programme, not by the graduate school; see the programme records.

toefl_min.value: The graduate school says a TOEFL iBT score of 90 is generally advised, but minimums vary by programme, so no university minimum is set.

ielts_min.value: The graduate school says an IELTS score of 6.5 is generally advised, but minimums vary by programme, so no university minimum is set.

english_waiver.value: A degree from an institution where English is the medium of instruction waives the English test, so an English-medium Indian degree qualifies unless a programme says otherwise.
english_waiver.quote: You have earned a college or university degree in the United States, in one of the countries listed above, or from an institution where English is the medium of instruction, prior to submitting your application.

notes: Covers the Graduate School of Arts and Sciences and School of Engineering (one application). The Graduate School of Biomedical Sciences has its own $90 application and English rules; see the tufts--biomed record. Official deadline charts print month and day with no year (e.g. 'Fall: December 1 (final)'), so deadlines are Not stated. Programme list: https://asegrad.tufts.edu/programs
